found.quote: Detection tools which purport to specifically focus on GenAI detection raise some significant implications for privacy, equity, and data security (Dalalah & Dalalah, 2023).
There is also a lack of evidence as to whether they are effective, with many institutions citing instances of false positives.
Note: Recording of lectures is not permitted without prior permission from the lecturer.
